newsitem.title: USA: Sano files for 2.15 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Sano files for 2.15 mln common shares.

text.p: Sano Corp filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday for up to 2.15 million common shares.
Of the total, the company said it will sell up to 1.25 million shares while certain shareholders may offer up to 900,000 shares.
Net proceeds will be used for research and development; capital expenditures, principally for manufacturing; licensing products; and for working capital and general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made through an underwriting group led by Volpe, Welty & Co. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 322,500 additional shares.
